updates.text: Started arc-length-of-xn: a paper on how fast the arc length of y = xⁿ approaches 2, with LaTeX source and a verification script.
Paper on arc length of y=xⁿ typeset in IEEE format, includes figures, tables, MIT license, and author affiliation.
Implemented a per‑instance SAT solver selector combining SATzilla features with GNN embeddings, adding a CLI harness, training scripts, and cost‑accounted evaluation.
Added IMU and 2D LiDAR sensors to the rover model, bridged them to ROS 2 topics /imu and /scan, and included a sensor mast link.
Started Vector-missile-interceptor: a real-time simulator for autonomous interception, built around a Kalman filter and proportional navigation.
A real‑time autonomous interception simulator with a Kalman filter, proportional navigation, and a GLFW+ImGui UI for mission control and Monte Carlo analysis.
Started hybrid-sat-selector: per-instance SAT solver selection that fuses SATzilla features with GNN embeddings; my Final Year Project.

Started MicroSlop: a terminal debloating tool that scans processes, startup entries, services, and context menu handlers, ranks them, and lets the user review and remove bloat with optional Gemini AI classification.
